title: Cardboard Packed
description: A lightweight and beautiful create-like experience
body:
## 🛩️ Cardboard Packed Modpack
A multiplayer experience tailored for engineering, automation, and large-scale exploration enthusiasts. Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge), this modpack expands vanilla horizons while keeping its core loop intact, giving you and your friends the tools to industrialize the world and conquer the skies.

<details>
<summary>Core Features</summary>

> #### 🚀 Industrial Revolution & Aeronautics
> The heart of this modpack revolves around movement, kinetic energy, and aviation:
> 
> - Create: Automate complex factories, process resources, and build incredible moving machinery using rotational power.
> 
> - Create Aeronautics: Take your inventions to the next level by building fully functional airships, flying vessels, and vehicles driven by real physics.
> 
> - Create Addons: Enhance your experience with Create: Central Kitchen, Copycats+, Dragons Plus, and Enchantment Industry to expand your cooking, decoration, and magic automation setup.
> 
> #### 🗺️ Revamped Exploration & Structures
> Overworld and dimensional exploration will never be the same:
> 
> - YUNG's Better Series: Dungeons, desert and jungle temples, Nether fortresses, mineshafts, and End strongholds have been completely redesigned to offer a true exploration challenge.
> 
> - Biolith & No Man's Land: Subtle, immersive tweaks to terrain generation and environment to make the world feel vast and untamed.
> 
> - Xaero's Minimap & World Map: Never get lost during your aerial journeys thanks to a fluid, detailed mapping system.
> 
> #### 🏡 Cozy Living, Cooking & Decoration
> For the quiet moments between massive engineering projects:
> 
> - Farmer's Delight: Grow new crops and cook complex meals that provide powerful buffs.
> 
> - Quark & Supplementaries: Hundreds of new decorative blocks, gameplay mechanics, and quality-of-life tweaks that make the world feel alive and interactive.
> 
> - Immersive Details: Take photographs (Exposure), draw with chalk (Chalk), sleep in sleeping bags (Comforts), and carry your gear in style (Backpacked).
> 
> #### ⚡ Server-Grade Performance Optimization
> We know that technical and physics-heavy mods can take a toll on performance. That’s why we’ve included an aggressive, professional-tier optimization suite:
> 
> - Graphics & Rendering: Equipped with Sodium, Iris (for Shaders), ImmediatelyFast, and EntityCulling.
> 
> - Server & Memory Optimization: Engine-level optimization with Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, and ServerCore to keep the server running at a stable 20 TPS, even with active factories and flying airships.

</details>
